terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server (HMR) for the Lykodex web app on http://localhost:5173. Runs logged-out unless VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are provided as secrets.

terminals.name: preview
terminals.command: npm run build && npm run preview -- --host --port 4173
terminals.description: Production preview: builds dist/ and serves the built bundle on http://localhost:4173. Closest to how the app runs in production.
